remarks: This beautiful 1 bedroom condo features hardwood floors, an updated kitchen and beautiful views of the park-like grounds of the complex from the balcony. Laundry is located conveniently in the condo itself. The complex features a private in ground pool and a clubhouse. The sidewalks throughout the complex weave through the professionally manicured grounds filled with mature trees, bushes, stunning green lawns, and flowers. This peaceful, quiet haven is the perfect retreat for the daily commuter. Close to 95 and a short drive to the Merritt, this location is also walking distance to the train station and is near a major bus route. Truly, a must see. No smoking or vaping. Landlord requires 1st months rent and 2 months security deposit upon signing of the lease. Only great credit scores and references will be considered.
